name: The Guide Light and the lantern
body: Ability 2. The companion's glow reveals hidden `glow_platform` pieces within a radius; the solo lantern does the same with a smaller radius and a cooler colour and has to be picked up. The gameplay (reveal radius, hidden pieces) is Nyx. Drawing the glow as a real light waits for the renderer's point lights, which another thread is adding; until then the reveal radius is drawn with the debug sphere only in the collision view.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.

Built in slice 2: the Guide Light (`GuideLight`, `GlowPlatform`, `GlowSystem`, `LanternPickup`), drawn as real point lights. Test: engine/tests/host/the-guide-light-shows-the-way. See docs/crimson-and-thorn-slice.md.
